subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler palavras novas com precisão na decodificação, no caso de palavras de uso frequente, ler globalmente, por memorização.

components.description_en: Use phonics knowledge to decode unfamiliar grade-level words in text
components.cc_component_description: Use phonics knowledge to decode unfamiliar grade-level words in text

components.description_pt: Reconhecer palavras frequentes comuns pela visão sem soletrar letras individuais
components.description_en: Recognize common high-frequency words by sight without sounding out individual letters
components.cc_component_description: Recognize common high-frequency words by sight without sounding out individual letters

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre palavras que exigem decodificação e aquelas reconhecidas pela visão

cc_matches.description: Read common high-frequency words by sight (e.g., the, of, to, you, she, my, is, are, do, does).
Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.
Identify words with inconsistent but common spelling-sound correspondences.
